summary: A mother and daughter who had agreed to disagree fought over a candidate's character and the mother left hours early.
realLife: A North Carolina mother and daughter had settled on agreeing to disagree after 2016. During a visit before the 2020 vote a fight about a candidate's character grew, and the daughter told her mother to leave. The mother left hours early. A week after the election the daughter sent a message, and the mother answered that they had many things to talk about, though politics was not one of them.
gates: The two are on record with opposite stands on {the candidate}.
A prior agreement to avoid the subject exists.
weights: Strength of feeling before a vote.
Love and a wish to reconnect after it.
inGame: A quarrel record, then a reconciliation scene, with a topic-ban note; needs: an agreement-to-avoid record that can be broken.

turns.what: No message is sent and the silence keeps going.
The reply comes but only about family news.
Contact returns only at a holiday months later.
